hypothesis: The existing interactive_v27 ready event is a coherent natural readiness boundary: gating endpoint publication on that event should preserve a later bounded clock wait that endpoint-only publication spends on startup.

pass.candidate_order: ready record emitted/appended before endpoint publication and endpoint publication before clock event
pass.authority: ready record and EventCursor results authority=none; endpoint grants no task authority
pass.negative_controls: suppressed ready, wrong-authority ready, unrelated early record all publish no endpoint

hold: HOLD_NO_NATURAL_READY_DISCRIMINATOR if baseline does not expose the fixed startup/read mismatch
limitations: Executable child is a test-only control-flow surrogate; exact interactive_v27 source order is verified separately from GitHub. The local socket harness reproduces the relevant v11 EventCursor/CommandOnce publication path but is not byte-identical to event_socket_v11. No real GUI startup claim.
